Minato-ku Japan") — it is not a language rendering of the roster's "17F Mita Kokusai Building, Mita 1-chome", it is a different building and street. **number fidelity — fail.** *Limits*: "one member is stored under a country that contradicts its own address line" understates the frozen family list, which shows at least four — YAZAKI COMPONENT TECHNOLOGY S.R.L. (country USA, address Arad Romania), XIAOGAN YAZAKI AUTO PARTS (country JPN, address Xiaogan City, Hubei, China — which the draft itself relies on without noting), ООО "ЯЗАКИ ВОЛГА" (country ITA), YAZAKI AUTOMOTIVE PRODUCTS TUNISIA (country HUN), YAZAKI U.K. LIMITED (country BEL).
